question: Which product/API contract should own the agent activity timeline: a metadata-only audit ledger, the existing trajectory/session surfaces, subagent lifecycle records, or an ephemeral UI-only observer?
rationale: The current code has multiple plausible source signals, but the durable storage owner, event taxonomy, authorization, retention, redaction, and UI/CLI scope are product and security choices rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Build on metadata audit foundation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable source of truth, then layer timeline views and exports on top of its redacted query contract.

options.title: Keep timeline ephemeral first
options.body: Limit the first implementation to live UI/TUI observation from existing event streams and defer durable query/export semantics.

options.title: Decline core timeline for now
options.body: Keep Activity, trajectory export, task lists, and plugin-specific activity rows as the supported observability surfaces until stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Build on metadata audit foundation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable source of truth, then layer timeline views and exports on top of its redacted query contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-audit direction and appears in the relevant state/lifecycle history.
